notes.title: Cube de Grace - Gameplay Stream
notes.notes: TRY NOW. Win battles and explore the galaxy to upgrade your collection. Add heroes and items to the mix and find your own way to control your fate.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have important news - Cube de Grace is participating in Steam Next Fest 🤩

You have the opportunity to play the demo version of the game with updated graphics, new characters, and expanded gameplay!

Play Cube de Grace and leave your feedback 😉

notes.title: Where have we gone and what have we done in the last month?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone who loves dice and adventures! 🎲 

You are probably wondering where we have gone and what we have done in the last month.

🧐 Let's learn everything!

We have been hard working getting ready for the Steam Festival. There are only a few weeks left before the last demo version of the Cube de Grace.

🔥 Speaking about finished aspects of the game, they are non-combat events (dialogues and the like), branched quest paths, characters, objects, and dice. 

In general, all aspects of the game out of combat are ready.

Now our team has almost completely reworked the content. New enemies, new abilities, changed effects, and, of course, adjusted balance are waiting for you!

It's high time to support us and wishlist Cube de Grace on STEAM ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: We are launching the Steam Cube de Grace community!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

With this post, we are launching the Steam Cube de Grace community here.
It's a new indie game made by a small team of game developers and Joy Way as a publisher.

The main idea is to make a collectible dice game with a mix of a classic RPG in a realistic fantasy setting.

Join our [url=discord.gg/g7fErbzuNj]Discord server[/url], and you will see the game's development and even participate in it live. Feel free to post your suggestions and feedback to the community. Every player is super valuable to us!
